rules.title: Test-Driven Development
rules.summary: red → green → refactor: failing test first, minimal code to pass, refactor after green.

rules.title: Behavior-Driven Development
rules.summary: EARS or Given/When/Then for every requirement; each scenario maps to one executable acceptance test.

rules.title: Domain-Driven Design
rules.summary: domain → application → infrastructure; dependencies inward only; ubiquitous language.

rules.title: Two-attempt rule
rules.summary: Two consecutive failures on same root cause → STOP, write diagnosis in VERIFICATION_REPORT.md, then resume.
forbid: more than 2 attempts at same root cause without written diagnosis
enforced_by: aidd-sensor.cjs (logs failures); agent discipline reads sensor log

rules.title: Non-inventive rule
rules.summary: If a fact, file, or requirement is missing, log a gap or ASK the user. Never fabricate.

rules.title: Spec is contract — inviolable
rules.summary: If a behavior, endpoint, field, or rule is not in requirements.md, design.md, or tasks.md, it MUST NOT be implemented. Gaps are blockers, not invitations to extrapolate.
forbid: implementing behavior not specified in requirements.md
choosing technologies/patterns not specified in design.md
implementing tasks out of order or adding bonus tasks not in tasks.md
filling spec ambiguity with agent judgment instead of stopping and asking
enforced_by: agent discipline (AIDD.md § Spec Boundary Rule); REVIEW gate Phase 11
